newsitem.title: USA: Praxair to meet margin growth target.
newsitem.headline: Praxair to meet margin growth target.

text.p: Praxair Inc, one of the largest gases companies in the world, said Wednesday it expected to meet during the fourth quarter its goal of reaching an 18-percent operating margin.
"We continue to believe we can meet our goal ...as we realize additional acquisition cost improvements worldwide," it said.
The company also said it foresaw continued earnings growth in 1997 and afterwards.
"Success with our growth strategies and productivity initiatives will set the stage for (growth)," it said.
Praxair reported $0.54 per share earnings for the third quarter against $0.44 during the same period last year.

Praxair said it had made progress during the third quarter in divesting "non-strategic" businesses associated with the acquisition of CBI Industries. It said it had reached agreements to sell five air separation plants in the United States and Spain, among other facilities.
